name: Careful Reader (Mythic)
body:
The written word cannot hurt someone of your mythic stature.

Prerequisite: Careful Reader.

Benefit: Your bonus on saving throws against written magical effects from Careful Reader doubles. By expending one use of mythic power, you can roll such a saving throw again and choose the best result.
